method.verification: Viewed both H and M complete pages and 600 dpi H front/right and M right crops. D03 hidden head boundaries do not permit counting valve covers. Clearly marked No.1/No.6 leaders, six inline in specifications, in-line side geometry and exact model headings support application. D01 PDF14 topology and P05/P06/P07/P09 photographs also viewed. Also opened GA01 (public Yanmar drawing preview), full sheet and enhanced detail crops. Counted six valve covers in the uppermost top projection. Lower VIEW FROM UPPER is mount-layout detail only. No full-resolution manufacturing drawing examined.

conflicts.decision: Preserve exhaust bellows and flange. GA01 front: nominal body endpoints +0.879/−0.5515 m; separate outgoing flange datum at +0.9885 m. These give height spans 1.4305 and 1.540 m for different features. D03 H flange outer silhouette gives about 1.560 m and is separately labelled ESTIMATED. +0.946 m is piston-removal clearance, never built geometry. Exact outer flange dimension remains UNVERIFIED.

acceptance.test: Assembled GLBs use m, right-handed Y-up at common crank/rear-main-block seam, +X toward damper, +Z non-operation/right. No duplicate flywheel or damper geometry. Crank journal and external rotating components share axis.

Check six inline cylinders, bore/stroke 155/180 mm, No.1-to-No.6 center spacing 1000 mm and flywheel-to-damper numbering. Use 200 mm equal pitch as an inferred modeling input. List measured error for each.

acceptance.feature: Catalogue nominal and physical drawing envelope
acceptance.test: Publish catalogue LWH and full assembly vertex AABB. Compare X to GA no-clutch WET 2.000 m, Y to both nominal physical body-plane span 1.4305 m and physical top flange GA datum-to-pan span 1.540 m, and Z to GA width 1.305 m. Use 1% education target only on like endpoints. Report AABB differences independently against both nominal and outline readings. Mark exact physical H match UNVERIFIED where differences depend on rear plumbing or outer flange edge. Do not clip/reroute to force nominal H=1.431 m.

Align H front/right and GA top/rear orthographic views to crank datum without nonuniform stretch. Target full WET engine-only X=2.000 m, including aft equipment identified in GA. H article X≈1.952 m is a projected abbreviated outline and reportable comparison only. Nominal Z=1.305 m. Compare upper flange and pan to drawing-defined surfaces separately from full AABB. Report model difference and dimensional evidence status for each.

Report observed assembled jumps/offsets at deck/liner/rocker/shaft/sump and compare documented spans before claims. Transverse depths and ports left null require drawings or direct measurements. ± bands in datum are drawing estimates, not OEM manufacturing tolerances.
